title: Equities Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for March, 5th (AAPL, AOBC, AOX, BAYN, BDGE, CRM, DAI, FME, GPOR, KGX)
text:
Equities Research Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Monday, March 5th: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was upgraded by analysts at Vetr from a hold rating to a buy rating. They currently have $184.49 target price on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts: 
American Outdoor Brands (NASDAQ:AOBC) had its outperform rating reissued by analysts at Wedbush. alstria office REIT (ETR:AOX) was given a €13.80 ($17.04) target price by analysts at Warburg Research. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
Bayer (FRA:BAYN) was given a €104.00 ($128.40) target price by analysts at Kepler Capital Markets. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. 
Bridge Bancorp (NASDAQ:BDGE) was upgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a strong sell rating to a sell rating. 
salesforce.com (NYSE:CRM) was downgraded by analysts at Vetr from a hold rating to a sell rating. Vetr currently has $116.00 target price on the stock. 
Daimler (ETR:DAI) was given a €80.00 ($98.77) target price by analysts at equinet AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
Fresenius Medical Care AG & Co. KGaA (ETR:FME) was given a €101.00 ($124.69) price target by analysts at Berenberg Bank. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
Gulfport Energy (NASDAQ:GPOR) was upgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a sell rating to a hold rating. 
Kion Group (FRA:KGX) was given a €85.00 ($104.94) price target by analysts at Citigroup Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
London Stock Exchange Group (LON:LSE) was given a GBX 4,500 ($62.17) target price by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
OceanFirst Financial (NASDAQ:OCFC) was upgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a sell rating to a hold rating. 
Pure Storage (NYSE:PSTG) was upgraded by analysts at Vetr from a buy rating to a strong-buy rating. They currently have $24.02 target price on the stock. 
Rio Tinto (LON:RIO) was given a GBX 4,000 ($55.26) target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. 
Triumph Bancorp (NASDAQ:TBK) was upgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a hold rating to a buy rating. 
Trade Desk (NASDAQ:TTD) was upgraded by analysts at Vetr from a hold rating to a buy rating. The firm currently has $56.79 price target on the stock.   Apple Inc   Apple Inc
